items_flat.title_en: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.7 for coding and knowledge work
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceXAI 推出 Grok 4.7，主打編程與知識工作
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced Grok 4.7 on September 21 as its most capable model for coding and knowledge work, using a larger base than Grok 4.6 plus a longer RL run on multi-hour tasks, stronger self-checking, and native Grok Bot harness training. It is live in Cursor, Grok Build, and the Grok API at the same $2/$6 per million tokens as 4.6, with a faster variant at double price. Official scores include 46.3% on CursorBench 4.0 and 71.0% high-effort on DeepSWE v1.1.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 於 9 月 21 日宣布 Grok 4.7，稱其為目前最強的編程與知識工作模型：基座大於 4.6、強化學習更長、自我核對更強，並原生理解 Grok Bot。已上線 Cursor、Grok Build 與 Grok API，價格維持每百萬 token $2/$6，另有雙倍價高速版。官方成績含 CursorBench 4.0 的 46.3% 與 DeepSWE v1.1 高努力 71.0%。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a same-price capability step, not a new pricing war: SpaceXAI is competing on long-horizon coding and office work while keeping 4.6 economics. Independent leaderboards and whether consumer Grok gets the same model remain the open checks against the launch charts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是同價升級而非價格戰：SpaceXAI 用長時程編程與辦公任務競爭，經濟條件與 4.6 持平。第三方排行與消費端 Grok App 是否同步上線，仍需對照官方圖表獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.7 is here. It's a notable improvement over Grok 4.6 at the same price and speed.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 來了。它在相同價格與速度下，相對 Grok 4.6 有明顯提升。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI partners with an independent math advisory group at IAS
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與高等研究院獨立數學顧問團合作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said an internal model whose training began August 28 has, beyond a claimed Navier–Stokes solution, now resolved more than 100 long-standing open problems. It is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence hosted at the Institute for Advanced Study to advise on reviewing, communicating, and standardizing emerging results and math tools. The unpaid group may publish unsolicited advice; OpenAI says it will not set the lab’s internal research pace.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，8 月 28 日開始訓練的內部模型除宣稱解決 Navier–Stokes 千禧年問題外，已再解決百題以上長期未解數學題。公司與高等研究院（IAS）主持的獨立「數學與人工智慧顧問團」合作，就結果審核、發布與研究標準提供建議。成員不支薪、可主動公開意見；OpenAI 明說該團不負責調控內部研究節奏。
items_flat.analysis_en: The institutional move is real; the 100-problem claim is still a company assertion pending community review. The group’s independence is designed for communication standards, not a brake on internal training.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 顧問機制本身可核對，但「百題已解」仍是公司主張、有待學界審視。該團定位是發布與標準，而非踩煞車。
items_flat.quote: The group will operate independently from OpenAI. ... Importantly, the group will not be responsible for advising us on how to pace our internal progress on mathematics.
items_flat.quote_zh: 該團獨立於 OpenAI 運作。……重要的是，它不負責建議我們如何調控數學方面的內部進度。

items_flat.title_en: HackerOne to embed Anthropic Mythos in exposure-management products
items_flat.title_zh: HackerOne 將把 Anthropic Mythos 嵌入曝險管理產品
items_flat.summary_en: HackerOne said on September 21 it will integrate Anthropic’s Claude Mythos into selected H1 Platform products, starting with H1 Code Security Audit and H1 Code, to connect agentic vulnerability discovery with validation and remediation. The firm cited a >50% improvement in critical MTTR over 12 months alongside a 29x growth in unresolved critical backlog.
items_flat.summary_zh: HackerOne 於 9 月 21 日宣布將把 Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos 整合進部分 H1 平台產品（先是 H1 Code Security Audit 與 H1 Code），把代理式漏洞發現接到驗證與修復。該公司指出近一年關鍵漏洞修復時間改善逾 50%，未解關鍵積壓卻成長 29 倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a partner distribution of Anthropic’s cyber-oriented model, not a new Claude launch. Whether Mythos findings reduce the backlog or mainly increase discovery volume is the operational test.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 網安向模型的通路落地，不是新版 Claude。Mythos 是縮小積壓還是只加快發現，仍待實務檢驗。
items_flat.quote: Frontier cyber AI will be available in select products in the H1 Platform to help enterprises uncover deeper risk and move from insight to action faster.
items_flat.quote_zh: 前沿網安 AI 將出現在部分 H1 平台產品中，協助企業挖出更深風險、更快從洞察走到行動。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA launches DSX Ready to qualify AI-factory power and cooling gear
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 推出 DSX Ready，認證 AI 工廠供電與冷卻設備
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced DSX Ready on September 21, a qualification program for partner products that meet DSX AI-factory reference requirements, starting with battery energy storage systems and cooling distribution units. Initial qualified names include Hitachi Energy, LG Energy Solution and Tesla for BESS, and LG Electronics, LiquidStack and Vertiv for CDUs.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 於 9 月 21 日宣布 DSX Ready，認證符合 DSX AI 工廠參考設計的合作夥伴產品，首批類別為電池儲能系統與冷卻分配單元。儲能初始名單含 Hitachi Energy、LG Energy Solution 與 Tesla；冷卻含 LG Electronics、LiquidStack 與 Vertiv。
items_flat.analysis_en: The constraint for frontier training is increasingly site power and cooling, not only GPUs. DSX Ready is a vendor-alignment program; it does not itself add compute capacity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 前沿訓練的瓶頸愈來愈是場址電力與冷卻，而不只是 GPU。DSX Ready 是供應鏈對齊計畫，本身不增加算力。
items_flat.quote: NVIDIA is introducing NVIDIA DSX Ready, a qualification program for partner products and solutions that meet applicable NVIDIA DSX AI factory reference design requirements.
items_flat.quote_zh: NVIDIA 推出 DSX Ready，認證符合 DSX AI 工廠參考設計要求的合作夥伴產品與方案。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands Academy with role-based learning paths
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴充 Academy 角色導向學習路徑
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI expanded OpenAI Academy with new courses for developers, leaders, educators, and college students, alongside Apply AI at Work. Paths cover Codex/API production work, adoption strategy, classroom use, and student workflows, with course assessments and Academy badges.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 擴充 Academy，新增開發者、領導者、教育者與大學生課程，並與既有 Apply AI at Work 並列。內容涵蓋 Codex/API 落地、導入策略、課堂與學生作業流程，通過評量可取得課程徽章。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a deployment-and-skilling product, not a model release. It tightens OpenAI’s hold on how enterprises and schools standardize agent workflows around ChatGPT and Codex.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是部署與技能產品，不是新模型。它強化企業與學校以 ChatGPT、Codex 為標準代理工作流的綁定。
items_flat.quote: At OpenAI, we treat learning as part of deployment. Today, we’re expanding OpenAI Academy with new courses for developers, leaders, educators, and college students.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在 OpenAI，我們把學習視為部署的一部分。今天我們為開發者、領導者、教育者與大學生擴充 Academy 新課程。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Finances adds Experian credit-score tracking
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT 財務功能新增 Experian 信用分數追蹤
items_flat.summary_en: ChatGPT release notes for September 21 say U.S. Plus and Pro users can connect an Experian credit report and VantageScore 3.0 in Finances for monthly updates and monitoring alerts. The Experian link is separate from Plaid bank connections. A Privacy Center is also rolling out to signed-in Free, Go, Plus, and Pro users.
items_flat.summary_zh: 9 月 21 日 ChatGPT 更新說明：美國 Plus 與 Pro 用戶可在財務功能連接 Experian 信用報告與 VantageScore 3.0，每月更新並可監控異動；此連線獨立於 Plaid 銀行帳戶。同時向已登入的 Free、Go、Plus、Pro 推出 Privacy Center。
items_flat.analysis_en: The consumer finance surface keeps deepening inside ChatGPT. Availability is U.S.-only and plan-gated; how insights are generated from bureau data is not independently audited in the note.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 消費金融場景持續內嵌 ChatGPT。目前僅美國付費方案；報告對信用資料如何被模型解讀並無獨立審計說明。
items_flat.quote: You can now track your credit score in ChatGPT. Securely connect your Experian® credit report and VantageScore® 3.0 credit score to get personalized insights.
items_flat.quote_zh: 你現在可以在 ChatGPT 追蹤信用分數。安全連接 Experian 信用報告與 VantageScore 3.0，取得個人化洞察。

items_flat.title_en: Hg extends Anthropic partnership to deploy Claude agents across its portfolio
items_flat.title_zh: Hg 擴大與 Anthropic 合作，向投資組合部署 Claude 代理
items_flat.summary_en: European software investor Hg said on September 21 it is extending a three-year Anthropic relationship so Hg Catalyst can deploy Claude agentic capabilities across portfolio companies. Hg cited more than 1,600 live AI projects and over $260 million of budgeted EBITDA impact.
items_flat.summary_zh: 歐洲軟體投資機構 Hg 於 9 月 21 日宣布延續與 Anthropic 三年合作，由 Hg Catalyst 把 Claude 代理能力推到投資組合公司。Hg 稱目前有逾 1,600 個進行中 AI 專案，預算 EBITDA 影響逾 2.6 億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is enterprise distribution of existing Claude agent features, not a model drop. The EBITDA figure is Hg’s internal budget claim, not an audited outcome.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有 Claude 代理的企業通路，不是新模型。EBITDA 數字來自 Hg 內部預算，非經審計成果。
items_flat.quote: Hg Catalyst and Anthropic will work more closely together on what it takes to make agentic AI deliver measurable results inside real businesses.
items_flat.quote_zh: Hg Catalyst 與 Anthropic 將更緊密合作，讓代理式 AI 在真實企業中交出可衡量成果。
